A [[Sy Myrthian/Legends|Sy Myrthian]] served as a '''consort'''<ref name="VD" /> and aide<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> to [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]], a corrupt [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="InsiderGuide">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> The consort was loyal to Toora,<ref name="DBToonbuck">{{DB|character|toonbucktoora|Toora, Toonbuck}}</ref> though she kept them as a symbol of her power.<ref name="InsiderGuide" /> Toora's aide had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and gray and white colored skin.<ref name="VD" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Toonbuck Toora's consort first appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>
